```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: fig-kmax-one
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP |> sprintf(paste(IDn.target, collapse = ", "), paste(IDg.target, collapse = ", "), paste(IDm.target, collapse = ", "), if (length(TR.target)) prettyNum(round(TR.target, 0), big.mark = ",") else "", paste(p.target, collapse = ", "), paste(.fmt(DAMAGE.CUTS, 1), collapse = ", "), SiteID.caption)
ENV <- new.env(parent = environment())
ENV$kmaxTable <- kmaxTable[Scenarios, on = .(IDg, IDm)]
ENV$siteID.target <- siteID.target
if (length(TR.target)) ENV$TR.target <- TR.target
STYLES <- c(rigid = "Solid", ensemble = "ShortDash", flexible = "LongDash")
LIST <- list()
for (n in IDn.target) {
  ENV$IDn.target <- n
  source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig/kmax.R"), local = ENV)
  LIST <- c(LIST, lapply(ENV$PLOT$x$hc_opts$series, function(Series) {
    Series$name <- paste(sub("^[^.]+\\.", "", Series$name), n, sep = ".")
    Series$dashStyle <- unname(STYLES[[n]])
    Series$lineWidth <- THICK_LINE_SIZE
    Series
  }))
}
PLOT <- ENV$PLOT
PLOT$x$hc_opts$series <- LIST
PLOT$x$hc_opts$legend$title <- NULL
PLOT$x$hc_opts$tooltip$pointFormat <- sub(
  "IDm.IDg: ", "", PLOT$x$hc_opts$tooltip$pointFormat, fixed = TRUE
)
rm(ENV, LIST, STYLES, n)
PLOT
```
